approvalScope: Bounded source and unit-test review of three live-reproduced in-page navigation failures in ContentPage, PrintHero and CareerHub; post-deployment browser acceptance remains required.

sourceAssessment.before: Native anchors in ContentPage, PrintHero and CareerHub coexist with React Router ScrollRestoration in BrandLayout. They bypass router-managed link navigation.
sourceAssessment.mechanism: Router ScrollRestoration prioritizes saved scroll position over fragment handling. Native hash history entries can reuse the current router location key; using router Links lets router navigation manage the entry and fragment consistently.
sourceAssessment.limits: The native history-event ordering was not instrumented in the live browser. The diagnosis is supported by the root live symptom, installed router source and focused regression tests.

sourceDelta.change: Replace only the reproduced links and equivalent ContentPage contents links with React Router Link to {search, hash}. Read full location.search in PrintHero and CareerHub so existing query parameters remain intact.
preserved: Normal route reset and Back restoration
Current full query parameters including non-preview UTM parameters
Other-brand HomeHero native anchor remains unchanged; no live failure was reproduced for it in this review
BrandLayout skip link remains unchanged; keyboard-focus acceptance is a separate concern
No new custom scroll effect or timers
sourceDelta.excludedPerformanceExperiment: PrinterScene exactly matches published main Git blob 2c11188520d6f141662795d6d9b13ad1bbe8c654; no asynchronous renderer or shader diagnostic change is included.

regressionFalsification.method: Temporarily restore only the original native anchors in each component, then run its navigation test file; restore fixed source exactly in a finally block.

coverage: Section, comparison, resource and FAQ links reach their target
Location-specific delivery link reaches its target
Hash link creates a router-managed location key
Home services CTA reaches its section and preserves full query parameters
Repeated click on the same home fragment returns to the target after scrolling elsewhere
Career opportunities CTA reaches its section instead of a saved unrelated position

releasePreflight.scope: Current certificate verification plus automated editorial records/referenced public assets audit. This is not a new full rendered-site or human semantic/provenance review.

limitations: No live post-fix acceptance or new performance score is claimed.
ContentPage and CareerHub are shared components. PrintHero is the 3D Yanımda hero. No brand content, other-brand hero anchor or skip-link focus behavior is changed.
No private analytics, account identifiers, OAuth URLs, credentials or browser screenshots are included.
